name: Nozomi Honda
source:
A bold and outspoken young girl. The youngest member of the Tea Party Club, and is often the instigator of conflict within the club. She absolutely hates liars and dishonest people, and doesn't have much of a filter.

[from [url=https://honeysweetlies.carrd.co/#characters]official website[/url]]
